Production Assitant Intern at CBS' internet radio station Chat About It

positions.description:
A list of responsibilities include:
•	Designed and wrote pocket guide profiling all 62 senate members and 150 assembly members using Microsoft Publisher
•	Wrote two press releases covering outstanding activists in the healthcare reform movement
•	Wrote and reviewed four speeches introducing CEO Tracey Brooks and other members of the FPA
•	Designed promotional materials for major advertising campaign
•	Used excel to take down data from alternative media ranging from contact information to demographics and political perspective

projects.title: Chugg'D
projects.description:
An online beer tastings tracker for craft beer lovers and enthusiasts.
•  Seeded a PostgreSQL database with beer and brewery data via the BreweryDB API and Ruby on Rails
•  Displayed beer tastings with comprehensive dashboard dynamically with jQuery and HTML
•  Collaborated in a agile group setting with 4 other classmates and used GitHub in conjunction for version control and branching
•  Authenticated users with Sessions and BCRYPT
• Deployed application on hosting service Heroku

projects.title: /Forum/
projects.description:
Forum App – A full-stack web forum application for users to post topics and threads with voting
• Wrote back end server using express
•  Created front end using EJS templating and the PURE CSS library
•  Seeded SQL database with relevant information
•  Deployed application on hosting service Digital Ocean
